questions.question: What does the acronym CMOS primarily refer to in the context of digital circuits?
options: Complementary Metal-Oxide-Semiconductor
Complex Multi-Order System
Central Memory Operating Speed
Current Mode Optical Sensor
Controlled Material Oxidized Silicon

questions.question: In a processor's memory management unit (MMU), what is the primary function of a Translation Lookaside Buffer (TLB)?
options: To cache frequently used data blocks from main memory.
To store recently executed instructions for faster re-execution.
To cache virtual-to-physical address translations.
To manage the allocation of physical memory pages.
To accelerate the lookup of interrupt service routines.

questions.question: Which technique allows a processor to execute instructions *before* it is certain whether they will be needed, particularly useful for optimizing performance around conditional branches?
options: Pipelining
Out-of-order execution
Speculative execution
Register renaming
Data forwarding

questions.question: In the physical design and verification of high-speed integrated circuits, what is the primary concern addressed by 'Signal Integrity (SI)' analysis?
options: Ensuring correct functionality of logic gates under varying supply voltages.
Preventing voltage drops in the power delivery network.
Analyzing undesirable electrical effects like crosstalk, reflection, and ground bounce on interconnects.
Verifying that the physical layout matches the logical schematic.
Optimizing the placement of standard cells to minimize area.

questions.question: In the context of verifying complex System-on-Chip (SoC) designs, what is the primary advantage of employing a coverage-driven verification (CDV) methodology?
options: To mathematically prove the absence of design bugs under all possible input sequences.
To automatically generate test vectors for manufacturing fault detection.
To guide the testbench development process to ensure adequate functional and structural coverage of the design.
To accelerate the simulation speed by using hardware acceleration platforms.
To formally verify the equivalence between different levels of design abstraction (e.g., RTL and gate-level netlist).
